changelog.body:
- [修复] 适配 HyperOS 3
---
- [Fix] Fix for HyperOS 3

- [修复] HyperOS 2 上的强制允许小窗在拖拽图标打开小窗或分屏时失效的问题
---
- [Fix] Force enable floating window failed on HyperOS 2 when dragging icon to open app in floating window

- [修复] 适配 HyperOS 2
- [修复] 应用选择界面图标展示
- [新增] 日语本地化
---
- [Fix] Fix for HyperOS 2
- [Fix] Application list icons
- [New] Japanese localization

- [新增] 选择应用移除小窗顶栏
---
- [New] Remove top bar of floating windows for selected apps

- [优化] MIUI解锁前台贴边同步上游，支持白名单（来自 [HChenX/ForegroundPin](https://github.com/HChenX/ForegroundPin)）
- [优化] 应用选择页面
- [优化] 项目重构
---
- [Optimize] Sync upstream for unlock foreground side-hide floating windows on MIUI, whitelist supported (from [HChenX/ForegroundPin](https://github.com/HChenX/ForegroundPin))
- [Optimize] Improve the app selection interface
- [Optimize] Project refactoring

- [修复] 手机上小窗与多开小窗桌面快捷菜单错误的将双开应用启动为主应用
---
- [Fix] Wrongly launching main apps instead of dual apps when using freeform and new task shortcut in the shortcut menu of system launcher on phone

- [新增] MIUI 上的解锁前台贴边（无白名单）（来自 [HChenX/ForegroundPin](https://github.com/HChenX/ForegroundPin)）
- [新增] 重置模块配置功能
- [修复] 错误的将 MIUI 检测为 HyperOS
---
- [New] Unlock foreground side-hide floating windows on MIUI (no whitelisting) (from [HChenX/ForegroundPin](https://github.com/HChenX/ForegroundPin))
- [New] Reset all settings feature
- [Fix] Wrongly detect MIUI as HyperOS

- [优化] 新增解锁前台贴边白名单
---
- [New] Whitelist for "Unlock foreground side-hide floating windows"

- [新增] 解锁单应用多任务小窗按钮
---
- [New] Unlock multiple task button

- [修复] HyperOS 上的强制允许小窗在拖拽图标打开小窗或分屏时失效的问题
- [新增] 桌面图标
- [新增] 适配 AOSP 多语言选择器
---
- [Fix] Force enable floating window failed on HyperOS when dragging icon to open app in floating window
- [New] Desktop Icons
- [New] Adapted AOSP Multilanguage Selector

- [新增] 隐藏小窗顶栏（仅 HyperOS）
- [新增] 移除小窗顶栏（仅 HyperOS）
- [新增] 移除小窗小白条（仅 HyperOS）
---
- [New] Visually hide top bar of floating windows (HyperOS Only)
- [New] Remove top bar of floating windows (HyperOS Only)
- [New] Remove bottom bar of floating windows (HyperOS Only)

- [新增] 解锁前台贴边（仅 HyperOS）
---
- [New] Unlock foreground side-hide floating windows (HyperOS Only)

- [修复] 全面适配 HyperOS
---
- [Fix] Fully Adapted to HyperOS

- [新增] 快捷菜单添加小窗与多开小窗
- [重构] 使用 EzXHelper 2.x 重构
---
- [New] Add freeform and new task shortcut
- [Refactor] Refactor using EzXHelper 2.x

- [修复] 平板，小窗与多开小窗快捷菜单不应显示在小部件上
---
- [Fix] Freeform and new task shortcut should not shown on widgets for pad

- [新增] 强制允许小窗
- [修改] 停止对安卓11的支持
---
- [New] Force enable floating window
- [Change] Stop supporting Android 11

- [修改] “忽略气泡通知设置”功能被“去除气泡通知应用限制”功能取代
- [修改] 修改部分功能描述
- [更新] 更新BlockMIUI
- [更新] 重构主页
---
- [Change] "Ignore conversation bubble settings" function has been replaced by "Remove conversation bubble settings restriction" function
- [Change] Change some function's description
- [Update] Update BlockMIUI
- [Update] Refactor main page

- [新增] 尝试修复气泡通知功能
- [新增] 重启所有作用域
- [更新] 更新BlockMIUI
---
- [New] Try to fix conversation bubbles function
- [New] Restart all scope
- [New] Update BlockMIUI

- [修复] 仅存在贴边小窗且贴边小窗数量大于1时无法通过手势开启迷你小窗
---
- [Fix] Unable to open mini floating window using gesture when has and only has multiple side-hide floating windows

- [新增] 图标
- [新增] 设置页
- [新增] 进入最近任务页面时所有小窗转为迷你小窗
- [修复] 最新桌面内测版下后台小窗按钮
---
- [New] Icon
- [New] Settings activity
- [New] Turn all floating windows into mini floating windows when entering Recents page
- [Fix] Open in floating window button in Recents page

- [修复] 气泡通知与悬浮通知同时出现的bug
---
- [Fix] Bubble notifications and floating notifications appear at the same time

- [新增] 忽略气泡通知设置（即不论气泡通知设置里是开是关，都显示气泡通知，包括设置里没有列出的其他应用）（请勾选新增的”手机管家“或”平板管家“作用域）
---
- [New] Dismiss bubble notifications settings (All apps in side-hide freeform will show bubble notifications now.) (Please check your xposed scope)

- 支持解锁手机贴边小窗特性（需要MIUI22.6.14及以上）
- 优化代码
- 更新EzXHelper至0.9.3
---
- Support unlocking side-hide freeform feature on phone devices (MIUI 22.6.14 or above is required)
- Optimize code
- Update EzXHelper to 0.9.3

- 修复存在贴边小窗时小窗的最大数量
- 新增一种hook，理论上更稳定
- 优化代码
---
- Fix max freeform count when there's side freeform
- Add a new hook to make the module more stable
- Optimize code

- 支持手机长按后台应用卡片使用小窗按钮呼出多小窗（请勾选系统桌面作用域）
- 移除多余hook
---
- Support using multi-smallwindow with smallwindow button in recent apps (Please check your xposed scope)
- Remove unnecessary hook

- 修改模块描述
---
- Update module description

- 解锁手机多小窗功能（需要使用全局侧边栏或从通知下拉为小窗实现）
- 解锁平板小窗数量限制
